name: Storage Hardware for AI: NVMe, SSD Endurance, Arrays and GPUDirect Storage
description: The hardware view of AI storage: NAND types and SSD internals, endurance and DWPD, NVMe and EDSFF form factors, PCIe Gen5 and Gen6 drives, high-capacity QLC, storage servers and arrays, NVMe over Fabrics, GPUDirect Storage and KV-cache storage tiers, and how to size bandwidth and capacity for training, checkpoints and inference. Reviewed against vendor sources as of October 2026.

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
